title: October 16: conditional residue reconstruction and causal explanation of grown networks
summary: Two deliberately separate lines. SihtiImageModel combines Sihti's exact heat-diffusion bands with offline PCA, ridge, example retrieval and fixed-size locally conditioned patch regression: patch addressing beats whole-image lookup on shifted digits and gives a small real-photo completion win, not a new semantic image generator. Growth-Microscope extends GrowingMatrix's physical routing question with prospective held-out conductance ablations, then discovers balanced groups from training causal signatures. Gate 3 functional groups predict damage but lose the strongest held-out RMSE comparison to simpler controls; the model is deterministic and linear. Video restoration through online retained detail is recorded only as an untested cross-repository application hypothesis.

nodes.claim: Builds a class-conditional no-backprop image generator and completion bench from exact Sihti diffusion bands; compares global PCA/residue retrieval with a 512-rule-per-band local coarse-to-fine patch predictor.
nodes.survived: Plain lattice sieve reconstructs at ~1e-16 without training. Global memory yields recognisable MNIST/Fashion samples but is example-dependent. Local patch P3 stores 903,168 values independent of training-count; shifted-digit PSNR is 20.38 vs global-memory 14.05 dB, and 300 held-out BSDS photos reach 25.12 vs 24.87 dB for an ordinary linear filter given core+r3.
nodes.killed: Sieve does not add 10-shot classification information: MNIST 68.8% vs raw 70.1%, Fashion 67.9% vs 69.2%. Fashion translation drops 0.53 dB and misses the 0.5-dB gate; core-only photo completion does not beat linear; defect image AUROC is 0.58. The photos are detail completion, not bird generation from scratch, and the model has no demonstrated online memory or temporal consistency.

nodes.claim: Deterministic causal interpretation lab for a budget-limited 11x9 passive Kirchhoff medium: preregistered training/validation/test routing, frozen intervention harm forecasts, and balanced edge groups learned from training finite-cut signatures without spatial coordinates.
nodes.survived: Offers a runnable three-gate browser and controlled source/sink experiments. Gate 1 causal fingerprints transfer across closely related endpoint shifts (Bridge r=0.987, Fork 0.951, Cross 0.825). Gate 2 freezes validation-selected growth before held-out 24-pair transport tests. Gate 3 groups 178 edges from three training causal signatures and prospectively measures ~49-51 selected-edge cuts over 12 held-out pairs.
nodes.killed: The specialized fingerprint does not outperform all simpler controls (Cross material-only r=0.849 > fingerprint 0.825; adjoint nearly perfect with privileged test-field access). Gate 2 diverse routing and early stopping do not consistently outperform an equal-material uniform baseline. Gate 3 functional groups are never the best held-out RMSE in six task/arm cases; 110/120 shuffled-partition comparisons beat their RMSE. Groups are hand-budgeted to 12 and induced from measured interventions, not discovered semantic neurons or proof of Goodfire-style interpretability.

edges.why: SihtiImageModel explicitly uses the Sihti lattice heat-diffusion sieve as its lossless multiscale input decomposition; the generation/readout components are new downstream tests.
Both test the limits of merely changing image/residue coordinates for downstream discrimination; the new repo references the earlier negative classification result without claiming code inheritance.
A conceptual comparison between future-sufficient memory and reconstruction-sufficient stored image detail; no future-prediction experiment transfers across these projects.

Growth-Microscope explicitly reconstructs a smaller, separate passive conductive growth fixture inspired by GrowingMatrix, to evaluate intervention-based explanations rather than importing its numerical results.
Both isolate how source/sink/question ports condition the apparent operator in a physical medium. Growth-Microscope does not train attention or duplicate Limasieni's equations.

motifs.title: A coarse state can address reusable missing detail
motifs.description: SihtiImageModel turns exact diffusion residues into an offline learned conditional patch rule. It beats global whole-image retrieval under translations but fails when the retained coarse address lacks enough structure. This is a reconstruction result, not temporal visual memory or a new semantic model.

motifs.title: Causal group discovery is only useful if it beats material and dynamics
motifs.description: Growth-Microscope clusters measured training intervention responses into groups and predicts unseen cuts, but simpler weight/flow/spatial/shuffled explanations often predict as well or better. Growth and query-port geometry matter; semantic neuron interpretation has not been demonstrated.

motifs.title: Retain observed visual details only when they help future predictions (open)
motifs.description: Unproven engineering direction connecting SihtiImageModel's coarse-to-fine local restoration with ResearchQuestion's future-sufficient state, Alavirta/Perjantai's sensory prediction loops and GraphNN's selective rewrites. No tested online video memory or restoration win exists yet.
